label.explanation: notif-db's data volume climbed past 90% (lines 125, 178, 213) and then filled, so every write failed with "No space left on device" (lines 227, 246, 250). notification-svc's notifications inserts fail as a direct result (lines 230, 239, 256); reads keep working, which is why only writes surface as api-gateway 500s (lines 225, 244, 252, 266, 273, 282, 290, 303, 311, 317, 332, 346). The insert errors look like data problems but the data is fine; it is storage. Red herrings: line 65 (a certificate expiry reminder weeks out); line 211 (a one-off slow reporting query on audit_log, not on the failing request path); line 217 (a config reload that changed nothing).
